description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewConfigureAjaxUI' class, which extends the SugarView class to implement the 'Configure Ajax UI' view in the SuiteCRM administration module. It handles permission checks, prepares data about enabled and disabled modules, and renders a template for configuring Ajax UI modules in the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: ViewConfigureAjaxUI
classes.description: Class to manage the Configure Ajax UI view within SuiteCRM administration, handling permission validation and template rendering.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the parameters for the module title, including a link to the Administration index and a label for AJAX configuration.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access control checks to ensure only admin users can access the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data on enabled and disabled modules and renders the configuration template.
